title: Fixed even geometric outer column at index 3
statement: The even geometric outer-column recognition statement specialized to the fixed index 3.

proof.text: For W=U and W=V, apply perfect_hom_open_colimit_local_comparison. Compactness is hU and hV.isCompact. The image containments follow from t.opensRange=U union V. Each canonical single-open group-colimit map therefore has the pinned local presentation; apply PerfectHomLocalMap.basic on the corresponding open.

The definition of column 3 identifies its underlying group with ULift Hom(P,(HU(E) biprod HV(E))[0]). Split a morphism by composition with the shifted biproduct projections; the inverse sums its compositions with the shifted inclusions. Functor additivity and biprod.total prove the inverse equations. The map_hom2 formula and biprod.map_fst/map_snd prove compatibility with every transition and apex leg.

Build the product cocone from the two local colimits using the stage splitting. Mathlib Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf recognizes it: choose representatives of the two coordinates and move them to a common stage for surjectivity; Types.FilteredColimit.isColimit_eq_iff identifies each coordinate at a later stage, and a common upper stage identifies both for injectivity. The unique colimit isomorphism gives a source equivalence pinned on every inclusion. Use PerfectHomLocalMap.basic on U and V, prod, and equiv with this source equivalence and the inverse apex splitting. Joint surjectivity of the underlying colimit inclusions and colimit.iota_desc identify the resulting map with the original column-3 comparison. The product-colimit and transport arguments are proved in full by the private helpers product_colimit_presentation and localMap_of_split_colimit in the delivered module.
